app_fee.value: The application fee is $70 and cannot be waived, deferred or refunded.
app_fee.quote: Payment of a non-refundable application fee of U.S. $70.00, which will not be waived, deferred, or refunded

fee_waiver.value: The $70 application fee cannot be waived for any applicant, international or domestic.
fee_waiver.quote: which will not be waived, deferred, or refunded

gre_general.value: The Graduate School says the GRE is not required for any program.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Records Exam is NOT required to apply for any program at MSU.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School lists TOEFL iBT 80, an old-scale score, so no number is recorded. Departments set their own TOEFL minimums (see program records).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum test scores from acceptable testing agencies are: TOEFL: 80-internet-based [iBT], IELTS: 6.5, or 120 Duolingo

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; most departments set higher.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list, so Indian applicants need an English test score.
english_waiver.quote: If your country is not listed, the requirement to supply and English proficiency exam will not be waived.

notes: Sources: Graduate School international admissions page (fetched 2026-10-27). The official graduate programs list (grad-programs/) gives the PhD list used for the program records. Not saved as program records: Neuroscience PhD (MCB page says it is not accepting applications; not on the official list); Biochemistry PhD is inside the chemistry record; Environmental Engineering PhD and Applied Mechanics are options of the Civil PhD in Engineering; IMSE PhD (Ph.D. in Engineering, Industrial Engineering Option) is noted in the mechanical record; Plant Genetics, Plant Pathology and Fish & Wildlife Biology PhDs were not researched; Psychological Science, Mathematics Education, Animal & Range Sciences, Exercise & Nutrition, and the non-STEM PhDs were out of scope. No data science, biomedical engineering or astronomy-only PhD appears on the official list (astrophysics is a research area of the physics PhD). No blocked URLs.
